traditional: 大概係 A 至 B 之間
jyutping: daai6 koi3 hai6 A zi3 B zi1 gaan1

english.note: Use this for an approximate point within a numerical range or other stated endpoints.

examples.english: This shirt costs somewhere between fifty and sixty dollars.
examples.traditional: 呢件衫大概係五十至六十蚊之間。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 daai6 koi3 hai6 ng5 sap6 zi3 luk6 sap6 man1 zi1 gaan1
